en: Tinted vintage postcard showing a tall rectangular medieval brick tower with crenellations and small square windows standing in an open square, with mountains in the background and a few people in early 20th‑century clothing in the foreground. Trees line a street on the left and multi‑story buildings border the right side. The word "Trento" appears at the upper right, "Torre Vanga" at the bottom center, and a publisher's imprint runs vertically along the left edge.
